title: clustarr
description: Values for the clustarr umbrella chart (0.5.0: the manager, agent and ui topology of spec 2026-10-06). Checks shapes (types, enums, known number/string formats) so a bad values file fails at `helm install`/`helm template`/`helm lint` with a schema-path error naming the exact key. The top level is closed: a key chart 0.5.0 retired (the eleven 0.4.x per-service blocks and keda, and image.controller/media/transcoder/transcoderCuda) fails here with a message naming its replacement; see the README's "Upgrading from 0.4.x". Cross-field invariants are clustarr.validate's in templates/_helpers.tpl. nats and cloudnative-pg pass through to the subcharts, which ship no schema of their own, and are checked only shallowly.

^catalog[a]rr$.const: retired in chart 0.5.0: its controllers run in the manager, so use manager (README, Upgrading from 0.4.x)

^catalog[a]rrMetadata$.const: retired in chart 0.5.0: use agents.metadata, which always runs one replica (README, Upgrading from 0.4.x)

^import[a]rr$.const: retired in chart 0.5.0: its controllers run in the manager, so use manager (README, Upgrading from 0.4.x)

^import[a]rrWorker$.const: retired in chart 0.5.0: use agents.import (README, Upgrading from 0.4.x)

^index[a]rr$.const: retired in chart 0.5.0: use agents.index (facade, resources) and manager.cardigann; replicas is gone (README, Upgrading from 0.4.x)

^grab[a]rr$.const: retired in chart 0.5.0: its controllers run in the manager, so use manager (README, Upgrading from 0.4.x)

^squas[h]arr$.const: retired in chart 0.5.0: use manager.slots, manager.intelRenderGroups and manager.gpuNodeLabel*; workerEngine is gone (README, Upgrading from 0.4.x)

^caption[a]rr$.const: retired in chart 0.5.0: its controllers run in the manager, so use manager (README, Upgrading from 0.4.x)

^caption[a]rrWorker$.const: retired in chart 0.5.0: use agents.caption; ackWaitSeconds is gone, the grace comes from the code (README, Upgrading from 0.4.x)

^segment[a]rrWorker$.const: retired in chart 0.5.0: use markers; concurrency: N becomes consumerSlots: {markers-analyze: N} (README, Upgrading from 0.4.x)

global.description: Injected by Helm into a chart with dependencies; clustarr reads nothing from it.

keda.const: retired in chart 0.5.0: use autoscaling.enabled; the manager scales the agents itself (README, Autoscaling)

clustarr.description: The static image: manager and ui.

native.description: The FROM-scratch image: agent, markers and transcode on FFmpeg 9 and ONNX Runtime; every agent, markers, the download engines and the transcode pools run it.

controller.const: retired in chart 0.5.0: use image.clustarr (README, Upgrading from 0.4.x)

media.const: retired in chart 0.5.0: everything that used it runs image.native (README, Upgrading from 0.4.x)

transcoder.const: retired in chart 0.5.0: use image.native (README, Upgrading from 0.4.x)

transcoderCuda.const: retired: there is no CUDA image (docs/adr/0015-no-cuda-image.md); nvidia pools run image.native

placement.description: The placement profile this Cluster takes with placement.enabled (placement.profiles).

primaryUpdateMethod.description: CNPG primaryUpdateMethod; switchover moves the release index off a node (control-plane placement design §5.5).

cluster-plex.description: Passes through to the cluster-plex subchart (its values.yaml); checked only shallowly.

placement.description: The placement profile this Cluster takes with placement.enabled (placement.profiles).

synchronous.description: CNPG postgresql.synchronous, rendered with more than one instance (control-plane placement design §5.1).

maxSlotWalKeepSize.description: max_slot_wal_keep_size with more than one instance.

primaryUpdateMethod.description: CNPG primaryUpdateMethod with more than one instance.

enabled.description: The manager owns the queue-driven workloads' HPAs and serves the External Metrics API they read; false renders fixed replicas, no APIService and --autoscale=false (README, "Autoscaling").

manager.description: Every controller in one process under the lease manager.clustarr.io; extra replicas (placement) are warm standbys.

replicas.description: Unset is 1, or with placement.enabled the profile's; more than a onePerNode profile allows fails the render.

goMemLimit.description: GOMEMLIMIT in Go's syntax, in place of 80% of resources.limits.memory.

watchReleaseNamespace.description: --watch-namespace=<release namespace>: cache only the release's namespace.

slots.description: manager --slots: comma-separated hardware=count pairs, e.g. cpu=2,nvidia=1,intel=1.

intelRenderGroups.description: manager --intel-render-groups: GIDs of the host group owning /dev/dri/renderD* on the Intel GPU nodes, added to every Intel transcode pod as supplementalGroups. Host-specific, so no default.

gpuNodeLabelNvidia.description: manager --gpu-node-label-nvidia override: the node label (set to "true") that marks an NVIDIA GPU node. Empty uses the binary's default, nvidia.com/gpu.present.

gpuNodeLabelIntel.description: manager --gpu-node-label-intel override: the node label (set to "true") that marks an Intel GPU node. Empty uses the binary's default, intel.feature.node.kubernetes.io/gpu.

bundled.description: manager --cardigann-bundled: load the Cardigann corpus compiled into the binary. false renders CLUSTARR_CARDIGANN_BUNDLED=false; true renders nothing (the binary's default). Moot when definitions mounts a directory, which replaces the corpus.

definitions.description: A directory of Cardigann definition files mounted read-only into the manager as --cardigann-definitions-dir, replacing the embedded corpus. Off while configMap and existingClaim are both empty. At most one may be set; clustarr.validate enforces that at render time, where it can say why.

configMap.description: An existing ConfigMap in the release namespace, one key per definition file. A ConfigMap holds at most 1 MiB.

existingClaim.description: An existing PersistentVolumeClaim holding the definition files.

subPath.description: Directory inside the ConfigMap or claim holding the files; empty is its root. Relative, so no leading '/' (the apiserver also refuses '..').

graftConcurrency.description: Audio grafts running at once in the namespace (--graft-concurrency): the admission ledger's graft slots.

engineMemoryLimits.description: The memory limit a download engine pod gets when its DownloadClient's spec.resources sets none; its GOMEMLIMIT is 80% of it. A DownloadClient's own memory limit wins.

concurrency.description: MediaFiles and items the remediation loop reconciles at once (--remediation-concurrency).

bulkWritesPerSecond.description: MediaFile status applies per second that no grant, answer, intent or first probe caused (--remediation-bulk-writes-per-second); 0 disables the pacing.

placement.description: The placement profile this workload takes with placement.enabled (placement.profiles).

livetv.description: Live TV (spec 2026-10-07): the manager's IPTV tuner, the <release>-livetv Service and the NetworkPolicy on the tuner port.

enabled.description: false renders --livetv-bind-address=0 and no livetv Service or NetworkPolicy.

port.description: The tuner's container port (--livetv-bind-address=:<port>); the livetv Service maps port 80 to it.

portRange.description: --livetv-port-range: the ports the blocks get, low-high. cluster-plex serves them on a link-local address inside its Plex pods.

enabled.description: Render a NetworkPolicy on the manager pod admitting the tuner port only from allowFrom; every other manager port stays open.

allowFrom.description: NetworkPolicyPeer list allowed to reach the tuner port. Default: Plex's pods (app.kubernetes.io/component: plex) in any namespace.

metadata.description: Always one replica, Recreate: the metadata gateway's provider rate limiters live in process memory (ADR-0007).

placement.description: The placement profile this workload takes with placement.enabled (placement.profiles).

index.description: Always one replica, Recreate: the release index, the RPC responders, the Torznab facade and the per-host limiter are one process (spec 2026-10-06, R4 amendment).

apiKeySecret.description: The facade's API-key Secret (--facade-api-key-secret on the manager and the index agent); empty means <release fullname>-index-facade, created by the manager.

placement.description: The placement profile this workload takes with placement.enabled (placement.profiles).

replicas.description: Used only with autoscaling.enabled=false: otherwise the manager's HPA owns the replica count and the Deployment carries none.

consumerSlots.description: Empty (the default): each pod runs one slot per coresPerSlot of the CPUs it can use, from 1 to 8. {markers-analyze: N}: every pod runs N slots, whatever its node (CLUSTARR_CONSUMER_SLOTS).

coresPerSlot.description: CPUs per automatic slot (--cores-per-slot): 2 by default, 1 where reads from /data bind before the CPUs do. Unused when consumerSlots names markers-analyze.

placement.description: The placement profile this workload takes with placement.enabled (placement.profiles).

auth.description: ui --auth-mode: the authentication mode, chosen explicitly (the binary refuses to serve without one). anonymous serves every request without a login, so the Service must sit behind ingress authentication (design amendment §A3.5).

pipelineHistory.description: Results the pipeline page keeps beside its in-flight entries (--pipeline-history); 0 shows in-flight entries only.

plex.description: The Plex Custom Metadata Provider (design spec §D): read-only, unauthenticated by protocol, must not sit behind a public ingress. See the chart README's "Plex provider" section.

plexGuids.description: --plex-guids: answer items Plex knows with their plex:// GUIDs, so Plex Web offers Watchlist.

externalURL.description: --external-url / $CLUSTARR_EXTERNAL_URL: the absolute base every thumb, art and Image[].url is built on. Empty means the provider roots answer 503 naming the flag.

placement.description: The placement profile this workload takes with placement.enabled (placement.profiles).

quantity.description: A Kubernetes resource.Quantity in binary or decimal SI form, e.g. 100Gi, 512Mi, 5000000.

cpuQuantity.description: A Kubernetes CPU quantity: cores ("1", "0.5") or millicores ("500m").

replicas.description: Used only with autoscaling.enabled=false: otherwise the manager's HPA owns the replica count and the Deployment carries none.

consumerSlots.description: Per-pod handler slots by consumer (CLUSTARR_CONSUMER_SLOTS), also the HPA's per-pod target; only the workload's own domain's consumers.
